sprint: "Change Look" Silently Orphans the Editor's Own Canvas
task: The user rejected the previous artworkTheme-restore fix as not matching the video: 'still no change . bug reported in video is as it is'. Continued the investigation by re-reading the entire write/override/redraw/render pipeline for a World-owned Text object a second time, confirming it was internally consistent, then auditing every other place SlideRenderer.init() retargets the app's one shared canvas reference away from #previewCanvas and back. Found the real bug in js/creationFlow.js: opening the Context Panel's '🔄 Change Look' shortcut renders each Page Style card via _repCard()/_renderCarouselCanvas(), which repoints SlideRenderer's shared canvas target at that card's own temp <canvas> -- and nothing in that whole flow (picking a card, or backing out) ever pointed it back to the real editor canvas, unlike Screen 2's own paintPreview(), which already correctly restores via the pre-existing _restoreEditorCanvas() helper right after building its carousel. Once a Story Author opens Change Look on any real themed project, #previewCanvas is silently, permanently orphaned for the rest of the session: every later content edit still correctly updates the model (the Words textarea, the render tree, Object Strip all read the model directly) but the visible canvas never repaints again -- an exact match to 'the Words field correctly updates but the canvas stays frozen... persisting through deselect and reselect', and consistent rather than timing-dependent, exactly as reported. Fixed by calling the existing _restoreEditorCanvas() at the end of _renderChangeRepresentationScreen(), mirroring paintPreview()'s own established pattern. Verified via a live git-stash A/B Playwright reproduction: on the unmodified code the canvas' own sampled title-region pixel count stayed byte-for-byte frozen across the edit (1501 before, 1501 after, even after an explicit extra redrawPreview() call) while the model/textarea correctly showed the new text -- the exact reported bug reproduced on demand for the first time in this investigation; with the fix restored the canvas genuinely repaints (1251 to 1010, matching this session's own established correct pixel-delta signature). Full regression: the three existing Change Look scratch suites pass unchanged; several older scratch scripts' pre-existing failures (a stale Traveller-Gateway locator, a documented pre-existing sticker-drag bug, a stale locator) were confirmed via git stash to already fail identically on the unmodified baseline, unrelated to this fix; a real Museum Gallery .vtheme render passes cleanly; both goldenBuild.js suites pass unchanged, confirming zero Builder-tooling impact. Confined entirely to one function, _renderChangeRepresentationScreen, in js/creationFlow.js.
